Subject: MAP: Redwood + Acme Healthcare  - draft & next steps

Hi Samantha 

Great to meet you and the team on today's discovery call. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Key outcomes:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood to serve inference for several internal clinical-assistant workflows.
- Top priorities: security/compliance evidence (SOC 2 + audit logs), predictable latency for 2k TPS burst, and cost predictability for pilot.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Security & Risk Review  - Acme: Security team review, Redwood: provide SOC2 report + audit log examples  - target: 2026-05-28
2) Pilot POC  - Redwood: provide test pod + onboarding playbook; Acme: sample data & success metrics  - target: 2026-06-30
3) Procurement & Contracting  - Acme: internal procurement and PO; Redwood: present SOW/terms  - target: 2026-06-30
4) Pilot Launch & Evaluation  - joint checkpoints, measurement of latency/cost  - target: 2026-07-30

Owner assignments are in the attached MAP draft. Proposed target close date for initial pilot contract: 2026-06-30.

Please review and let me know which milestones need adjusting or if we should move any target dates. If helpful, we can put a short MAP review on the calendar this week.

Attachments: [Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

- Procurement: we're updating our FY26 priorities; finance is pushing to re-prioritize non-core platform work into Q3. That may push contracting and PO timing out. I'll loop Carlos from procurement for specific timing.
- Stakeholders: Carlos Mendez (procurement) and Dr. Emily Park (Clinical Ops) will be pulled into follow-ups.

Tentative ask: can we re-forecast target close to mid-September if procurement sign-off slips? If you can provide the SOC2 artifacts + a redlined SOW/SOW pricing by next week, that helps our budgeting conversation.

On scheduling  - I'd like a short 30-min MAP review with your team and Carlos next week. I'm available Thu 5/14 10-12 PT.
